target_policy.rationale: Turbofan wear is physically undetectable during early cruise cycles. Capping the target at 125 cycles concentrates loss minimization on the active maintenance decision window without distorting gradient steps.

feature_pipeline.architecture: Temporal Causal Rolling Windows + First-Cycle Baseline Drift

mlflow_evaluation: MLflow was evaluated as an artifact tracking option. For this self-contained NASA C-MAPSS benchmark research prototype, introducing MLflow would add heavy dependencies (sqlite/psycopg2, alembic, greenlet, sqlalchemy, cloudpickle, databricks-sdk), a separate tracking server, and container bloat without runtime benefit. An immutable, cryptographic JSON manifest with SHA-256 checksums provides 100% auditable, deterministic, zero-overhead lineage that runs entirely offline and container-native.
